snippet.title: Abiotic Factor - Entropic Break | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and much more in this paid expansion for Abiotic Factor!

Wishlist Today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4687390/Abiotic_Factor__Entropic_Break/

Available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam Autumn 2026.

Get Abiotic Factor today, available for purchase or as part of Game Pass Ultimate and PlayStation Plus Extra.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/427410/Abiotic_Factor/
Xbox: https://xbox.com/games/store/abiotic-factor/9p4nv23q6qc2
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012483/
